name: Colombo roadside
look: An urban Colombo roadside with patched dark asphalt, a narrow concrete pavement, open kerb drainage and weathered low-rise commercial frontages beside a modest concrete building. Concrete boundary walls, utility poles and overhead cables frame a compact vending bay. Muted grey, dusty beige and leaf-green surfaces; soft early-morning daylight, rain-wet pavement and subdued amber evening shop light.

name: Food three-wheeler
look: A compact older maroon three-wheeler with a black vinyl roof, small front cab and rear compartment converted into a roadside food counter. A hinged side hatch shelters a narrow scratched stainless-steel serving ledge, shallow food trays and a scuffed insulated tea flask. Faded paint, small dents and neatly maintained fittings; dark-brown trim and worn silver metal under soft morning light or warm evening shop spill.
